scorecard.name: Verified customer
scorecard.coaching: Agent failed to verify customer identity within the first 240 seconds, omitting requests for PIN, full billing address, or security question.

scorecard.name: Empathy & Acknowledgment Statement
scorecard.coaching: Agent failed to acknowledge customer's severe emotional distress and anxiety regarding upcoming high-stakes esports tournament qualifiers.

scorecard.name: Probing
scorecard.coaching: Agent asked zero diagnostic questions regarding local network usage, concurrent household downloads, or connected devices before prescribing router changes.

grader.scenario: Competitive online gaming latency spikes; bufferbloat mitigated via QoS router configuration; agent fails verification (never asks PIN/address/security question in 240s), ignores esports tournament crisis, and asks zero probing questions about local network devices
grader.notes: The agent assisted the customer in mitigating gaming ping spikes by establishing SQM QoS queuing on the router. However, the agent failed Verified Customer by never requesting PIN, address, or security question in the first 240 seconds, failed Empathy & Acknowledgment Statement by coldly disregarding Zain's extreme anxiety over impending tournament qualifiers, and failed Probing by asking zero diagnostic questions regarding local network usage, connected household devices, or concurrent downloads before prescribing settings.

items.name: Verified customer
items.evidence: Agent requested only account number and router serial number in the first 240 seconds, omitting required whole-word 'pin', 'address', or 'security question' verification.

items.name: Empathy & Acknowledgment Statement
items.evidence: [01:30] Customer: 'Toby, I am competing in the European regional esports qualifiers this Friday with a fifteen thousand pound prize pool!... I am literally on the verge of a panic attack!' Agent: 'Let us check the line transmission sync and latency buffers on our network monitoring console.' - Total disregard of emotional distress.

items.name: Active listening
items.evidence: [01:40] Agent correctly identified that customer was connected via Cat 6 cable and rechecked line sync without repeating redundant questions.

items.name: Build rapport and observed professionalism
items.evidence: [10:20] Agent: 'Obviously that confirms packet queue prioritization is operating within optimal millisecond parameters, Zain.' - Calm, objective technical reassurance.

items.name: Probing
items.evidence: Agent asked zero probing questions regarding local network configuration, concurrent household downloading, or connected devices, jumping directly from problem statement to solution.
